entities.label: RESPONDENT

sentences.text: This is the fifth application filed by the applicant under Section 439 of the Cr.P.C. for grant of bail relating to FIR No. 267 of 2022 registered at Police Station Vijaypur, District Sheopur (M.P.) for the offence under Sections 376, 324 and 506 of IPC.
After arguing for a while, counsel for the applicant seeks for and is permitted to withdraw this bail application.
It is further prayed that trial Court be directed to conclude the trial as expeditiously as possible in view of the custody period of the present applicant.
The application is accordingly dismissed as withdrawn.
Trial Court is directed to conclude the trial as expeditiously as possible in accordance with law.

(SUNITA YADAV) JUDGE (LJ*)
